description: Single-channel, precision, low-noise CMOS-input op amp with rail-to-rail output. It has a 17 MHz gain-bandwidth product, 100 fA input bias current, 5.8 nV/√Hz input voltage noise and ±150 µV maximum offset, and runs from a 1.8 V to 5.5 V supply.

groups.description: Single-supply or split-supply rails V+ and V−. The total supply range is 1.8 V to 5.5 V (2.0 V to 5.5 V from −40 °C to 125 °C), with a 6.0 V absolute maximum. Quiescent current is 1.15 mA typical at 5 V.
groups.name: POWER

groups.description: The analog signal pins of the op amp: non-inverting input (+IN), inverting input (−IN) and the rail-to-rail output. The inputs are high-impedance CMOS with a common-mode range that includes the negative rail.
groups.name: OTHER

pins.description: Amplifier output, rail-to-rail. It swings to within about 32 mV (typical) of either rail with a 2 kΩ load at 5 V. Short-circuit current is about 66 mA sourcing and 23 mA sinking (typical, 5 V).
pins.name: OUTPUT

pins.description: Negative supply rail. Connect it to ground for single-supply use, or to the negative rail for split-supply use. The total supply V+ − V− must be 1.8 V to 5.5 V (6.0 V absolute maximum).
pins.name: V-

pins.description: Non-inverting input, with a CMOS input stage and 100 fA typical input bias current. Common-mode range is −0.3 V to 4 V at a 5 V supply. Input pins are limited to V+ +0.3 V and V− −0.3 V, and to ±0.3 V differential.
pins.name: +IN

pins.description: Inverting input, with a CMOS input stage and 100 fA typical input bias current. Common-mode range is −0.3 V to 4 V at a 5 V supply. Absolute maximum is ±0.3 V differential relative to +IN.
pins.name: -IN

pins.description: Positive supply rail, 1.8 V to 5.5 V relative to V− (2.0 V minimum below 0 °C). Supply current is 1.15 mA typical. Bypass it to V− close to the pin.
pins.name: V+

variants.notes: This is the only package listed for the single-channel LMP7715. θJA is 180 °C/W. The ordering suffixes and body dimensions come from TI convention, not from the pages read.
This package is for the dual LMP7716/LMP7716Q, a different device from the LMP7715. Pinout: 1 OUT A, 2 −IN A, 3 +IN A, 4 V−, 5 +IN B, 6 −IN B, 7 OUT B, 8 V+. θJA is 236 °C/W.
